items.title: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans
items.why: Issuer-led agent payment pilots are a live template; check whether Chase plans to bring this model to US cardholders.
items.summary_ai: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card are developing financial transactions that AI agents initiate without a human in the loop.
